utterance_starts.first_words: Señor presidente: en realidad este tema me toca muy de cerca. Fui comandante antártico
Tiene la palabra el señor senador Agúndez.
Señor presidente: a los fines prácticos y por compartir las inquietudes de quienes han hecho
Tiene la palabra el señor senador Villaverde.
Señor presidente: la iniciativa que sobre este tema he presentado consta de cinco puntos
Tiene la palabra el señor senador Maglietti.
Señor presidente: estoy de acuerdo con las mociones formuladas en este recinto, pero quiero

notes: Seven turns, all of them plain floor speech on the Antarctic bases; no inserted documents. The stretch begins exactly on Ulloa's label, so nothing opens mid-speech. In the wider sitting file, the two things immediately before this stretch are an italic stage note that vice-president León takes the chair and León's turn giving Ulloa the floor; both fall outside the stretch and are not listed. The bold runs are broken inconsistently and I recorded the printed result, not the markup: Ulloa prints as bold 'Sr. Ulloa' with the '. --' outside the bold, and the three chair labels all print 'Sr. Presidente (León). --' although the first keeps '. --' inside a second bold run and the other two leave it outside. All three chair turns are one line of business each ('Tiene la palabra el señor senador ...'); they are short but they are turns. The stretch ends in the middle of Maglietti's speech. No stenographer's notes, no headings, no back-links or other furniture in this fragment.
